    rLangmuir_Variance := ((rLangmuirHeatFlux_MWm2_Probe1 - rTempCalc1) * (rLangmuirHeatFlux_MWm2_Probe1 - rTempCalc1) +
                           (rLangmuirHeatFlux_MWm2_Probe2 - rTempCalc1) * (rLangmuirHeatFlux_MWm2_Probe2 - rTempCalc1) +
                           (rLangmuirHeatFlux_MWm2_Probe3 - rTempCalc1) * (rLangmuirHeatFlux_MWm2_Probe3 - rTempCalc1)) / 3.0;

    (* Check for single-probe deviation *)
    IF (ABS(rLangmuirHeatFlux_MWm2_Probe1 - rLangmuir_Voted_HeatFlux) > rLangmuir_MaxDeviation_MWm2) THEN
        bLangmuir_Probe1_Fault := TRUE;
        bLangmuir_Disagreement_Warning := TRUE;
    END_IF;
    IF (ABS(rLangmuirHeatFlux_MWm2_Probe2 - rLangmuir_Voted_HeatFlux) > rLangmuir_MaxDeviation_MWm2) THEN
        bLangmuir_Probe2_Fault := TRUE;
        bLangmuir_Disagreement_Warning := TRUE;
    END_IF;
    IF (ABS(rLangmuirHeatFlux_MWm2_Probe3 - rLangmuir_Voted_HeatFlux) > rLangmuir_MaxDeviation_MWm2) THEN
        bLangmuir_Probe3_Fault := TRUE;
        bLangmuir_Disagreement_Warning := TRUE;
    END_IF;

ELSIF iLangmuir_ValidCount = 2 THEN
    (* 2 probes valid: 2oo2 Average *)
    bLangmuir_Disagreement_Warning := TRUE;
    IF bLangmuir_1_Valid AND bLangmuir_2_Valid THEN
        rLangmuir_Voted_HeatFlux := (rLangmuirHeatFlux_MWm2_Probe1 + rLangmuirHeatFlux_MWm2_Probe2) * 0.5;
        bLangmuir_Probe3_Fault := TRUE;
    ELSIF bLangmuir_1_Valid AND bLangmuir_3_Valid THEN
        rLangmuir_Voted_HeatFlux := (rLangmuirHeatFlux_MWm2_Probe1 + rLangmuirHeatFlux_MWm2_Probe3) * 0.5;
        bLangmuir_Probe2_Fault := TRUE;
    ELSE
        rLangmuir_Voted_HeatFlux := (rLangmuirHeatFlux_MWm2_Probe2 + rLangmuirHeatFlux_MWm2_Probe3) * 0.5;
        bLangmuir_Probe1_Fault := TRUE;
    END_IF;
    rLangmuir_Variance := 1.0;

ELSIF iLangmuir_ValidCount = 1 THEN
    (* 1 probe valid: Degraded 1oo1 *)
    IF bLangmuir_1_Valid THEN
        rLangmuir_Voted_HeatFlux := rLangmuirHeatFlux_MWm2_Probe1;
        bLangmuir_Probe2_Fault := TRUE;
        bLangmuir_Probe3_Fault := TRUE;
    ELSIF bLangmuir_2_Valid THEN
        rLangmuir_Voted_HeatFlux := rLangmuirHeatFlux_MWm2_Probe2;
        bLangmuir_Probe1_Fault := TRUE;
        bLangmuir_Probe3_Fault := TRUE;
    ELSE
        rLangmuir_Voted_HeatFlux := rLangmuirHeatFlux_MWm2_Probe3;
        bLangmuir_Probe1_Fault := TRUE;
        bLangmuir_Probe2_Fault := TRUE;
    END_IF;
    rLangmuir_Variance := 4.0;

ELSE
    (* All probes invalid (0 valid): Langmuir Diagnostic Blackout *)
    bLangmuir_Probe1_Fault := TRUE;
    bLangmuir_Probe2_Fault := TRUE;
    bLangmuir_Probe3_Fault := TRUE;
    rLangmuir_Voted_HeatFlux := aX_Hat[2]; (* Fallback to observer state *)
    rLangmuir_Variance := 15.0;
    wDiagnosticFaultWord := wDiagnosticFaultWord OR 16#0002; (* Bit 1: Total Langmuir Loss *)
END_IF;

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
   BLOCK 5: SECONDARY DIAGNOSTIC FUSION: IR CAMERA & BOLOMETRY RECONCILIATION
   Cross-verifies voted Langmuir heat flux against optical surface thermography
   ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* Plausibility check on IR thermography camera reading *)
IF (rIRCameraSurfaceTemp_DegC >= 20.0) AND (rIRCameraSurfaceTemp_DegC <= 2500.0) THEN
    (* Reconcile surface temperature using 1D semi-infinite slab thermal model:
       T_surf ~ T_bulk + q_target * (thickness / k_tungsten)
       With thickness = 0.010 m (10 mm armor) and k_tungsten ~ 140 W/(m*K)
       DeltaT = q [W/m2] * (0.01 / 140) = q [MW/m2] * 1e6 * 7.1428e-5 = q [MW/m2] * 71.43 deg C
    *)
    rCalculatedSurfaceTemp_DegC := rDivertorTileTemp_DegC + (rLangmuir_Voted_HeatFlux * 71.43);

    (* If Langmuir probe indicates detachment (low heat flux) but IR camera detects scorching surface (>800 deg C),
       detect sheath breakdown / Langmuir probe short circuit and raise warning *)
    IF (rLangmuir_Voted_HeatFlux < 3.0) AND (rIRCameraSurfaceTemp_DegC > 750.0) THEN
        wDiagnosticFaultWord := wDiagnosticFaultWord OR 16#0004; (* Bit 2: Probe Sheath Breakdown / False Detachment *)
        (* Override voted heat flux with IR thermal inversion value *)
        rLangmuir_Voted_HeatFlux := (rIRCameraSurfaceTemp_DegC - rDivertorTileTemp_DegC) / 71.43;
        IF rLangmuir_Voted_HeatFlux < 0.0 THEN rLangmuir_Voted_HeatFlux := 0.0; END_IF;
    END_IF;
ELSE
    wDiagnosticFaultWord := wDiagnosticFaultWord OR 16#0008; (* Bit 3: IR Camera Blind / Window Coated *)
END_IF;

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
   BLOCK 6: PLASMA POWER BALANCE & DIVERTOR EXHAUST METRICS
   Computes radiative fraction f_rad and total power across separatrix P_sep
   ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* Total heating power = Auxiliary (NBI+ECRH+ICRH) + Ohmic heating (Ip * V_loop) *)
rTempCalc1 := (rPlasmaCurrent_kA * 1000.0) * rLoopVoltage_V * 1.0E-6; (* Ohmic power [MW] *)
IF rTempCalc1 < 0.0 THEN rTempCalc1 := 0.0; END_IF;
rTempCalc2 := rTotalAuxiliaryPower_MW + rTempCalc1; (* Total heating power P_tot [MW] *)

(* Power across separatrix: P_sep = P_tot - P_rad,core *)
IF rTempCalc2 > rBolometerPradCore_MW THEN
    rTempCalc3 := rTempCalc2 - rBolometerPradCore_MW;
ELSE
    rTempCalc3 := 0.50; (* Minimum residual loss power *)
END_IF;

(* Radiative fraction: f_rad = (P_rad,core + P_rad,div) / P_tot *)
IF rTempCalc2 > 1.0 THEN
    rRadiativeFraction := (rBolometerPradCore_MW + rBolometerPradDivertor_MW) / rTempCalc2;
ELSE
    rRadiativeFraction := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* Bound radiative fraction *)
IF rRadiativeFraction > 1.20 THEN
    rRadiativeFraction := 1.20;
    wAlarmCodeWord := wAlarmCodeWord OR 16#0010; (* Bit 4: Radiation Collapse / MARFE Risk *)
END_IF;

(* Divertor thermal margin relative to 10.0 MW/m2 steady-state limit *)
IF rLangmuir_Voted_HeatFlux < C_MAX_STEADY_HEAT_FLUX_MWM2 THEN
    rDivertorThermalMargin_Pct := ((C_MAX_STEADY_HEAT_FLUX_MWM2 - rLangmuir_Voted_HeatFlux) / C_MAX_STEADY_HEAT_FLUX_MWM2) * 100.0;
ELSE
    rDivertorThermalMargin_Pct := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
   BLOCK 7: 5th-ORDER DISCRETE-TIME STATE-SPACE OBSERVER (KALMAN/LUENBERGER)
   Reconciles physical dynamics with noisy / degraded sensor measurements
   Step 1: Measurement vector update
   Step 2: Predicted state: x_pred = A * x_hat + B * u
   Step 3: Predicted output: y_hat = C * x_pred + D * u
   Step 4: Innovation: y_innov = y_meas - y_hat
   Step 5: Corrected state: x_hat = x_pred + L * y_innov
   ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* Reconciled measurement vector *)
aY_Meas[1] := rThomson_Voted_Te;
aY_Meas[2] := rLangmuir_Voted_HeatFlux;
aY_Meas[3] := rDivertorTileTemp_DegC;

(* Current control vector [N2, Ne, Ar] *)
aU_Control[1] := rActualFlow_N2_Pam3s;
aU_Control[2] := rActualFlow_Ne_Pam3s;
aU_Control[3] := rActualFlow_Ar_Pam3s;

(* Step 2: x_pred = A * x_hat + B * u *)
FOR iIdx := 1 TO 5 DO
    rTempDotProduct := 0.0;
    FOR jIdx := 1 TO 5 DO
        rTempDotProduct := rTempDotProduct + (aA_Matrix[iIdx, jIdx] * aX_Hat[jIdx]);
    END_FOR;
    FOR kIdx := 1 TO 3 DO
        rTempDotProduct := rTempDotProduct + (aB_Matrix[iIdx, kIdx] * aU_Control[kIdx]);
    END_FOR;
    aX_Pred[iIdx] := rTempDotProduct;
END_FOR;

(* Step 3: y_hat = C * x_pred + D * u *)
FOR iIdx := 1 TO 3 DO
    rTempDotProduct := 0.0;
    FOR jIdx := 1 TO 5 DO
        rTempDotProduct := rTempDotProduct + (aC_Matrix[iIdx, jIdx] * aX_Pred[jIdx]);
    END_FOR;
    FOR kIdx := 1 TO 3 DO
        rTempDotProduct := rTempDotProduct + (aD_Matrix[iIdx, kIdx] * aU_Control[kIdx]);
    END_FOR;
    aY_Hat[iIdx] := rTempDotProduct;
END_FOR;

(* Step 4: Innovation y_innov = y_meas - y_hat with sensor fault masking *)
FOR iIdx := 1 TO 3 DO
    (* If specific diagnostic is in total failure, suppress innovation to avoid corrupting observer *)
    IF (iIdx = 1) AND (iThomson_ValidCount = 0) THEN
        aY_Innov[1] := 0.0; (* Zero innovation on Thomson total failure *)
    ELSIF (iIdx = 2) AND (iLangmuir_ValidCount = 0) THEN
        aY_Innov[2] := 0.0; (* Zero innovation on Langmuir total failure *)
    ELSE
        aY_Innov[iIdx] := aY_Meas[iIdx] - aY_Hat[iIdx];
    END_IF;
END_FOR;

(* Step 5: x_hat = x_pred + L * y_innov *)
FOR iIdx := 1 TO 5 DO
    rTempDotProduct := 0.0;
    FOR jIdx := 1 TO 3 DO
        rTempDotProduct := rTempDotProduct + (aL_Matrix[iIdx, jIdx] * aY_Innov[jIdx]);
    END_FOR;
    aX_Hat[iIdx] := aX_Pred[iIdx] + rTempDotProduct;
END_FOR;

(* Apply physical realism saturation bounds to estimated states *)
IF aX_Hat[1] < 0.20 THEN aX_Hat[1] := 0.20; END_IF;      (* Te_div cannot be below 0.2 eV *)
IF aX_Hat[1] > 150.0 THEN aX_Hat[1] := 150.0; END_IF;
IF aX_Hat[2] < 0.00 THEN aX_Hat[2] := 0.00; END_IF;      (* q_div cannot be negative *)
IF aX_Hat[2] > 60.0 THEN aX_Hat[2] := 60.0; END_IF;
IF aX_Hat[3] < 0.001 THEN aX_Hat[3] := 0.001; END_IF;   (* Neutral pressure lower limit *)
IF aX_Hat[4] < 0.00 THEN aX_Hat[4] := 0.00; END_IF;      (* Prad_div cannot be negative *)
IF aX_Hat[5] < 20.0 THEN aX_Hat[5] := 20.0; END_IF;      (* T_monoblock minimum room temperature *)

(* Transfer observer states to output variables *)
rEstimatedTe_eV := aX_Hat[1];
rEstimatedHeatFlux_MWm2 := aX_Hat[2];
rEstimatedNeutralPressure_Pa := aX_Hat[3];
rEstimatedPradDivertor_MW := aX_Hat[4];
rEstimatedMonoblockTemp_DegC := aX_Hat[5];

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
   BLOCK 8: GRACEFUL DEGRADATION HIERARCHY & SENSOR ISOLATION
   Determines system capability level based on remaining diagnostic redundancy
   ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
IF (iThomson_ValidCount = 3) AND (iLangmuir_ValidCount = 3) THEN
    iDegradedModeLevel := 0; (* Tier 0: Full nominal 2oo3 redundancy across all diagnostics *)
    bDetachmentDegraded := FALSE;
ELSIF (iThomson_ValidCount >= 2) AND (iLangmuir_ValidCount >= 2) THEN
    iDegradedModeLevel := 1; (* Tier 1: Single channel fault; operating in 2oo2 degraded voting *)
    bDetachmentDegraded := FALSE;
ELSIF (iThomson_ValidCount = 0) AND (iLangmuir_ValidCount >= 2) THEN
    iDegradedModeLevel := 2; (* Tier 2: Thomson lost completely; Langmuir primary + IR camera cross-check *)
    bDetachmentDegraded := TRUE;
    wDiagnosticFaultWord := wDiagnosticFaultWord OR 16#0020; (* Bit 5: Degraded Mode 2 Active *)
ELSIF (iThomson_ValidCount >= 2) AND (iLangmuir_ValidCount = 0) THEN
    iDegradedModeLevel := 3; (* Tier 3: Langmuir lost completely; Thomson primary + Observer state reconstruction *)
    bDetachmentDegraded := TRUE;
    wDiagnosticFaultWord := wDiagnosticFaultWord OR 16#0040; (* Bit 6: Degraded Mode 3 Active *)
ELSE
    iDegradedModeLevel := 4; (* Tier 4: Multiple severe failures; Safe conservative feedforward puffing & soft stop *)
    bDetachmentDegraded := TRUE;
    wDiagnosticFaultWord := wDiagnosticFaultWord OR 16#0080; (* Bit 7: Critical Degradation Mode 4 Active *)
    bSoftStopRequested := TRUE;
END_IF;

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
   BLOCK 9: MODEL PREDICTIVE CONTROL (MPC) REFINED QUADRATIC OPTIMIZATION
   Solves constrained quadratic cost function:
       min J = 1/2 * DeltaU^T * H * DeltaU + g^T * DeltaU
   Tracking: rTargetHeatFlux_MWm2, rTargetTe_eV, and maintaining radiative fraction
   ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* Construct 3x3 Hessian Matrix H:
   Diagonal dominance guaranteed by actuator slew-rate regularization weights.
   Cross-coupling terms reflect physical impurity radiation overlap.
*)
aHessian[1,1] := (rWeight_Q * 0.0156) + (rWeight_Te * 0.0072) + rWeight_Rate_N2;
aHessian[1,2] := (rWeight_Q * 0.0122) + (rWeight_Te * 0.0035);
aHessian[1,3] := (rWeight_Q * 0.0181) + (rWeight_Te * 0.0015);

aHessian[2,1] := aHessian[1,2];
aHessian[2,2] := (rWeight_Q * 0.0096) + (rWeight_Te * 0.0018) + rWeight_Rate_Ne;
aHessian[2,3] := (rWeight_Q * 0.0142) + (rWeight_Te * 0.0008);

aHessian[3,1] := aHessian[1,3];
aHessian[3,2] := aHessian[2,3];
aHessian[3,3] := (rWeight_Q * 0.0210) + (rWeight_Te * 0.0003) + rWeight_Rate_Ar;

(* Construct 3x1 Cost Gradient Vector g:
   Calculates error between observer states and setpoints:
   e_q = rEstimatedHeatFlux_MWm2 - rTargetHeatFlux_MWm2
   e_te = rEstimatedTe_eV - rTargetTe_eV
*)
rTempCalc1 := rEstimatedHeatFlux_MWm2 - rTargetHeatFlux_MWm2;
rTempCalc2 := rEstimatedTe_eV - rTargetTe_eV;

aGradient[1] := (rWeight_Q * rTempCalc1 * (-0.125)) + (rWeight_Te * rTempCalc2 * (-0.085));
aGradient[2] := (rWeight_Q * rTempCalc1 * (-0.098)) + (rWeight_Te * rTempCalc2 * (-0.042));
aGradient[3] := (rWeight_Q * rTempCalc1 * (-0.145)) + (rWeight_Te * rTempCalc2 * (-0.018));

(* Penalize Argon usage if core radiation is approaching safety limit *)
IF rBolometerPradCore_MW > 0.45 * rTempCalc2 THEN
    aGradient[3] := aGradient[3] + 15.0; (* Heavily disincentivize additional Argon puffing *)
END_IF;

(* Boost N2 gradient during ELM burst event *)
IF bELM_EventTrigger THEN
    aGradient[1] := aGradient[1] - 8.5; (* Demand rapid Nitrogen surge *)
END_IF;

(* Active-Set Projected Gradient Solver (8 deterministic iterations per scan cycle) *)
aDeltaU[1] := 0.0;
aDeltaU[2] := 0.0;
aDeltaU[3] := 0.0;

FOR iQPIteration := 1 TO 8 DO
    (* Compute gradient of cost: grad_J = H * DeltaU + g *)
    FOR iIdx := 1 TO 3 DO
        rTempDotProduct := 0.0;
        FOR jIdx := 1 TO 3 DO
            rTempDotProduct := rTempDotProduct + (aHessian[iIdx, jIdx] * aDeltaU[jIdx]);
        END_FOR;
        rTempDotProduct := rTempDotProduct + aGradient[iIdx];

        (* Projected gradient step *)
        aDeltaU_Trial[iIdx] := aDeltaU[iIdx] - (rStepSize_Alpha * rTempDotProduct);

        (* Slew-rate constraint: -DeltaU_max <= DeltaU <= DeltaU_max *)
        rUpperBound := C_MAX_SLEW_RATE_PAM3S2 * rCycleTime_s;
        rLowerBound := -rUpperBound;

        IF aDeltaU_Trial[iIdx] > rUpperBound THEN
            aDeltaU_Trial[iIdx] := rUpperBound;
        ELSIF aDeltaU_Trial[iIdx] < rLowerBound THEN
            aDeltaU_Trial[iIdx] := rLowerBound;
        END_IF;

        (* Absolute actuator saturation projection: 0 <= U_prev + DeltaU <= U_max *)
        IF iIdx = 1 THEN
            rUpperBound := C_MAX_VALVE_N2_PAM3S - aU_Prev[1];
            rLowerBound := 0.0 - aU_Prev[1];
        ELSIF iIdx = 2 THEN
            rUpperBound := C_MAX_VALVE_NE_PAM3S - aU_Prev[2];
            rLowerBound := 0.0 - aU_Prev[2];
        ELSE
            rUpperBound := C_MAX_VALVE_AR_PAM3S - aU_Prev[3];
            rLowerBound := 0.0 - aU_Prev[3];
        END_IF;

        IF aDeltaU_Trial[iIdx] > rUpperBound THEN
            aDeltaU_Trial[iIdx] := rUpperBound;
        ELSIF aDeltaU_Trial[iIdx] < rLowerBound THEN
            aDeltaU_Trial[iIdx] := rLowerBound;
        END_IF;

        aDeltaU[iIdx] := aDeltaU_Trial[iIdx];
    END_FOR;
END_FOR;

(* Calculate unconstrained target flows *)
rTargetFlow_N2_Pam3s := aU_Prev[1] + aDeltaU[1];
rTargetFlow_Ne_Pam3s := aU_Prev[2] + aDeltaU[2];
rTargetFlow_Ar_Pam3s := aU_Prev[3] + aDeltaU[3];

(* Clamp to non-negative physical bounds *)
IF rTargetFlow_N2_Pam3s < 0.0 THEN rTargetFlow_N2_Pam3s := 0.0; END_IF;
IF rTargetFlow_Ne_Pam3s < 0.0 THEN rTargetFlow_Ne_Pam3s := 0.0; END_IF;
IF rTargetFlow_Ar_Pam3s < 0.0 THEN rTargetFlow_Ar_Pam3s := 0.0; END_IF;

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
   BLOCK 10: SUPERSONIC ACTUATOR DYNAMICS & CHOKED NOZZLE PRESSURE COMPENSATION
   Applies sonic choked flow formula: Q_max = C_conductance * P_manifold
   Filters demand through piezoelectric and solenoid lag time constants
   ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* Manifold pressure sanity check (minimum 2.0 bar required for supersonic jet formation) *)
IF rGasManifoldPressure_N2_bar < 2.0 THEN
    wDiagnosticFaultWord := wDiagnosticFaultWord OR 16#0100; (* Bit 8: Low N2 Plenum Pressure *)
    rTempCalc1 := rGasManifoldPressure_N2_bar * rChokedConductance_N2;
    IF rTargetFlow_N2_Pam3s > rTempCalc1 THEN rTargetFlow_N2_Pam3s := rTempCalc1; END_IF;
END_IF;

IF rGasManifoldPressure_Ne_bar < 2.0 THEN
    wDiagnosticFaultWord := wDiagnosticFaultWord OR 16#0200; (* Bit 9: Low Ne Plenum Pressure *)
    rTempCalc2 := rGasManifoldPressure_Ne_bar * rChokedConductance_Ne;
    IF rTargetFlow_Ne_Pam3s > rTempCalc2 THEN rTargetFlow_Ne_Pam3s := rTempCalc2; END_IF;
END_IF;

IF rGasManifoldPressure_Ar_bar < 2.0 THEN
    wDiagnosticFaultWord := wDiagnosticFaultWord OR 16#0400; (* Bit 10: Low Ar Plenum Pressure *)
    rTempCalc3 := rGasManifoldPressure_Ar_bar * rChokedConductance_Ar;
    IF rTargetFlow_Ar_Pam3s > rTempCalc3 THEN rTargetFlow_Ar_Pam3s := rTempCalc3; END_IF;
END_IF;

(* Dynamic lag simulation / filter representing valve electro-mechanical response *)
IF rPiezoTimeConstant_s > 0.0 THEN
    rTempCalc1 := rCycleTime_s / (rPiezoTimeConstant_s + rCycleTime_s);
    rActualFlow_N2_Pam3s := rActualFlow_N2_Pam3s + rTempCalc1 * (rTargetFlow_N2_Pam3s - rActualFlow_N2_Pam3s);
    rActualFlow_Ne_Pam3s := rActualFlow_Ne_Pam3s + rTempCalc1 * (rTargetFlow_Ne_Pam3s - rActualFlow_Ne_Pam3s);
ELSE
    rActualFlow_N2_Pam3s := rTargetFlow_N2_Pam3s;
    rActualFlow_Ne_Pam3s := rTargetFlow_Ne_Pam3s;
END_IF;

IF rSolenoidTimeConstant_s > 0.0 THEN
    rTempCalc2 := rCycleTime_s / (rSolenoidTimeConstant_s + rCycleTime_s);
    rActualFlow_Ar_Pam3s := rActualFlow_Ar_Pam3s + rTempCalc2 * (rTargetFlow_Ar_Pam3s - rActualFlow_Ar_Pam3s);
ELSE
    rActualFlow_Ar_Pam3s := rTargetFlow_Ar_Pam3s;
END_IF;

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
   BLOCK 11: MAIN FINITE STATE MACHINE (CASE iActiveState OF)
   Multi-stage deterministic operational lifecycle:
   0: INIT_BOOTSTRAP - Sensor zeroing, memory priming, sanity test
   10: STANDBY_PRE_SHOT - Vacuum verification, cooling water flow, manifold pressures
   20: PLASMA_RAMP_UP - Waiting for breakdown, monitoring current ramp, pre-puff gas priming
   30: ATTACHED_DIVERTOR_MONITORING - Plasma attached, sheath conduction, rising heat flux
   40: DETACHMENT_TRANSITION_RAMP - Closed-loop impurity seeding ramp initiation
   50: STEADY_STATE_DETACHED_REGIME - Target regime active (Te < 5 eV, q_div < 10 MW/m2)
   60: TRANSIENT_HEAT_BURST_MITIGATION - ELM transient or MARFE excursion suppression
   70: CONTROLLED_RAMP_DOWN - Plasma termination, gas cutoff, cryopump recovery
   80: RUNAWAY_ELECTRON_MITIGATION_TRIP - MGI/SPI valve fired, safety isolation
   90: FAULT_LOCKOUT_GRACEFUL_DEGRADATION - Lockout, diagnostic recovery, emergency soft landing
   ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
CASE iActiveState OF

    0: (* -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
          STATE 0: INIT_BOOTSTRAP
          ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
        bSystemReady := FALSE;
        bDetachmentAchieved := FALSE;
        rValveDemand_N2_Pam3s := 0.0;
        rValveDemand_Ne_Pam3s := 0.0;
        rValveDemand_Ar_Pam3s := 0.0;
        rStateTimer_s := rStateTimer_s + rCycleTime_s;

        (* Perform initialization checks *)
        IF (rCycleTime_s >= 0.0005) AND (rCycleTime_s <= 0.010) AND bObserverInitialized THEN
            IF rStateTimer_s > 0.100 THEN
                rStateTimer_s := 0.0;
                iActiveState := 10; (* Advance to STANDBY_PRE_SHOT *)
            END_IF;
        END_IF;

    10: (* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
          STATE 10: STANDBY_PRE_SHOT
          ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
        rValveDemand_N2_Pam3s := 0.0;
        rValveDemand_Ne_Pam3s := 0.0;
        rValveDemand_Ar_Pam3s := 0.0;
        bDetachmentAchieved := FALSE;
        rStateTimer_s := rStateTimer_s + rCycleTime_s;

        (* Verify vacuum base pressure, coolant flow, and manifold pressures *)
        IF (rCoolingWaterFlow_m3h >= C_MIN_COOLING_FLOW_M3H) AND
           (rGasManifoldPressure_N2_bar >= 5.0) AND
           (rGasManifoldPressure_Ne_bar >= 5.0) AND
           (rGasManifoldPressure_Ar_bar >= 5.0) AND
           (rSubDivertorNeutralPressure_Pa <= 0.10) THEN
            bSystemReady := TRUE;
            wSystemStatusWord := wSystemStatusWord OR 16#0001; (* Bit 0: System Ready *)
        ELSE
            bSystemReady := FALSE;
            wSystemStatusWord := wSystemStatusWord AND 16#FFFE;
        END_IF;

        (* Shot Sequencer Trigger: Plasma current initiation *)
        IF bSystemReady AND bPlasmaShotActive AND (rPlasmaCurrent_kA > 100.0) THEN
            rStateTimer_s := 0.0;
            iActiveState := 20; (* Advance to PLASMA_RAMP_UP *)
            wSystemStatusWord := wSystemStatusWord OR 16#0002; (* Bit 1: Shot Active *)
        END_IF;

    20: (* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
          STATE 20: PLASMA_RAMP_UP
          ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
        bSystemReady := TRUE;
        bDetachmentAchieved := FALSE;
        rStateTimer_s := rStateTimer_s + rCycleTime_s;
        iShotExecutionCounter := iShotExecutionCounter + 1;

        (* Pre-puff priming: Small feedforward puff of Nitrogen to condition sub-divertor neutral pressure *)
        IF rSubDivertorNeutralPressure_Pa < 0.20 THEN
            rValveDemand_N2_Pam3s := 5.0; (* Pre-puff 5 Pa*m3/s *)
        ELSE
            rValveDemand_N2_Pam3s := 0.0;
        END_IF;
        rValveDemand_Ne_Pam3s := 0.0;
        rValveDemand_Ar_Pam3s := 0.0;

        (* Check for transition to flat-top attached divertor when Ip > 80% nominal (e.g. > 800 kA) *)
        IF (rPlasmaCurrent_kA > 800.0) AND (rTotalAuxiliaryPower_MW > 2.0) THEN
            rStateTimer_s := 0.0;
            iActiveState := 30; (* Advance to ATTACHED_DIVERTOR_MONITORING *)
            wSystemStatusWord := wSystemStatusWord OR 16#0004; (* Bit 2: Flat-Top Reached *)
        END_IF;

        (* Disruption or premature abort during ramp-up *)
        IF NOT bPlasmaShotActive THEN
            iActiveState := 70; (* Ramp down *)
        END_IF;

    30: (* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
          STATE 30: ATTACHED_DIVERTOR_MONITORING
          Plasma is in high-recycling attached regime: Te > 15 eV, heat flux rapidly increasing
          ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
        bDetachmentAchieved := FALSE;
        rStateTimer_s := rStateTimer_s + rCycleTime_s;
        rAttachedDuration_s := rAttachedDuration_s + rCycleTime_s;

        (* Feedforward baseline gas puffing while preparing closed-loop transition *)
        rValveDemand_N2_Pam3s := 10.0;
        rValveDemand_Ne_Pam3s := 0.0;
        rValveDemand_Ar_Pam3s := 0.0;

        (* Detect need for radiative detachment initiation:
           Condition: Target heat flux approaching 6.0 MW/m2 OR auxiliary power > 5.0 MW
        *)
        IF (rEstimatedHeatFlux_MWm2 > 6.0) OR (rTotalAuxiliaryPower_MW > 5.0) THEN
            rStateTimer_s := 0.0;
            iActiveState := 40; (* Advance to DETACHMENT_TRANSITION_RAMP *)
            wSystemStatusWord := wSystemStatusWord OR 16#0008; (* Bit 3: Detachment Ramp Active *)
        END_IF;

        (* Guard: If heat flux spikes catastrophically past 12.0 MW/m2 in attached regime *)
        IF rEstimatedHeatFlux_MWm2 > 12.0 THEN
            iActiveState := 60; (* Emergency Transient Heat Burst Mitigation *)
        END_IF;

    40: (* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
          STATE 40: DETACHMENT_TRANSITION_RAMP
          Closed-loop MPC optimization engages to drive Te down to < 5.0 eV and q_target < 5.0 MW/m2
          ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
        bDetachmentAchieved := FALSE;
        rStateTimer_s := rStateTimer_s + rCycleTime_s;

        (* Engage closed-loop MPC outputs *)
        rValveDemand_N2_Pam3s := rActualFlow_N2_Pam3s;
        rValveDemand_Ne_Pam3s := rActualFlow_Ne_Pam3s;
        rValveDemand_Ar_Pam3s := rActualFlow_Ar_Pam3s;

        (* Verify Detachment Criteria:
           1. Estimated electron temperature Te < C_MAX_DETACHED_TE_EV (5.0 eV)
           2. Estimated heat flux q_div < C_MAX_STEADY_HEAT_FLUX_MWM2 (10.0 MW/m2)
           3. Stable condition sustained for at least 50 ms (50 cycles)
        *)
        IF (rEstimatedTe_eV <= C_MAX_DETACHED_TE_EV) AND (rEstimatedHeatFlux_MWm2 <= 7.0) THEN
            IF rStateTimer_s > 0.050 THEN
                rStateTimer_s := 0.0;
                iActiveState := 50; (* Advance to STEADY_STATE_DETACHED_REGIME *)
                wSystemStatusWord := wSystemStatusWord OR 16#0010; (* Bit 4: Detachment Achieved *)
            END_IF;
        ELSE
            (* Reset timer if detachment conditions are not yet sustained *)
            IF rStateTimer_s > 2.0 THEN
                (* If ramp takes longer than 2.0 seconds without achieving detachment, raise warning *)
                wAlarmCodeWord := wAlarmCodeWord OR 16#0020; (* Bit 5: Detachment Ramp Timeout *)
            END_IF;
        END_IF;

    50: (* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
          STATE 50: STEADY_STATE_DETACHED_REGIME
          Optimal operational state: Te in 1.5 - 3.5 eV window, heat flux < 5.0 MW/m2
          ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
        bDetachmentAchieved := TRUE;
        rStateTimer_s := rStateTimer_s + rCycleTime_s;
        rDetachmentDuration_s := rDetachmentDuration_s + rCycleTime_s;

        (* Closed-loop MPC governs all three actuators *)
        rValveDemand_N2_Pam3s := rActualFlow_N2_Pam3s;
        rValveDemand_Ne_Pam3s := rActualFlow_Ne_Pam3s;
        rValveDemand_Ar_Pam3s := rActualFlow_Ar_Pam3s;

        (* Monitor for Loss of Detachment (Attachment Snap-Back):
           If Te exceeds 6.5 eV OR heat flux surges above 9.0 MW/m2
        *)
        IF (rEstimatedTe_eV > 6.5) OR (rEstimatedHeatFlux_MWm2 > 9.0) THEN
            bDetachmentAchieved := FALSE;
            wAlarmCodeWord := wAlarmCodeWord OR 16#0040; (* Bit 6: Attachment Snap-Back Excursion *)
            rStateTimer_s := 0.0;
            iActiveState := 60; (* Transition to TRANSIENT_HEAT_BURST_MITIGATION *)
        END_IF;

        (* Monitor for ELM burst event trigger *)
        IF bELM_EventTrigger THEN
            rStateTimer_s := 0.0;
            iActiveState := 60;
        END_IF;

        (* Normal shot termination sequence initiated *)
        IF NOT bPlasmaShotActive THEN
            rStateTimer_s := 0.0;
            iActiveState := 70; (* Transition to CONTROLLED_RAMP_DOWN *)
        END_IF;

    60: (* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
          STATE 60: TRANSIENT_HEAT_BURST_MITIGATION
          Handles ELMs, detachment collapse, or sudden power surges via aggressive gas boosting
          ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
        rStateTimer_s := rStateTimer_s + rCycleTime_s;
        rHeatBurstDuration_s := rHeatBurstDuration_s + rCycleTime_s;

        (* Rapid gas boost: Apply 50% boost over MPC demand on Nitrogen and Neon *)
        rValveDemand_N2_Pam3s := rActualFlow_N2_Pam3s + 35.0;
        IF rValveDemand_N2_Pam3s > C_MAX_VALVE_N2_PAM3S THEN
            rValveDemand_N2_Pam3s := C_MAX_VALVE_N2_PAM3S;
        END_IF;

        rValveDemand_Ne_Pam3s := rActualFlow_Ne_Pam3s + 20.0;
        IF rValveDemand_Ne_Pam3s > C_MAX_VALVE_NE_PAM3S THEN
            rValveDemand_Ne_Pam3s := C_MAX_VALVE_NE_PAM3S;
        END_IF;

        rValveDemand_Ar_Pam3s := rActualFlow_Ar_Pam3s;

        (* Evaluate recovery:
           If heat flux drops back below 6.0 MW/m2 and Te < 4.5 eV for at least 40 ms
        *)
        IF (rEstimatedHeatFlux_MWm2 < 6.0) AND (rEstimatedTe_eV < 4.5) THEN
            IF rStateTimer_s > 0.040 THEN
                rStateTimer_s := 0.0;
                iActiveState := 50; (* Return to steady-state detached regime *)
            END_IF;
        END_IF;

        (* Failsafe: If heat burst persists longer than 350 ms, request supervisory soft stop *)
        IF rStateTimer_s > 0.350 THEN
            bSoftStopRequested := TRUE;
            wAlarmCodeWord := wAlarmCodeWord OR 16#0080; (* Bit 7: Sustained Heat Burst Excursion *)
        END_IF;

    70: (* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
          STATE 70: CONTROLLED_RAMP_DOWN
          Plasma current rampdown and termination: cut off impurity puffing, flush cryopumps
          ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
        bDetachmentAchieved := FALSE;
        rStateTimer_s := rStateTimer_s + rCycleTime_s;

        (* Smooth exponential decay of impurity gas demands *)
        rValveDemand_N2_Pam3s := rValveDemand_N2_Pam3s * 0.95;
        rValveDemand_Ne_Pam3s := rValveDemand_Ne_Pam3s * 0.95;
        rValveDemand_Ar_Pam3s := rValveDemand_Ar_Pam3s * 0.90;

        IF rValveDemand_N2_Pam3s < 0.1 THEN rValveDemand_N2_Pam3s := 0.0; END_IF;
        IF rValveDemand_Ne_Pam3s < 0.1 THEN rValveDemand_Ne_Pam3s := 0.0; END_IF;
        IF rValveDemand_Ar_Pam3s < 0.1 THEN rValveDemand_Ar_Pam3s := 0.0; END_IF;

        (* Plasma current completely extinguished (Ip < 50 kA) *)
        IF rPlasmaCurrent_kA < 50.0 THEN
            rValveDemand_N2_Pam3s := 0.0;
            rValveDemand_Ne_Pam3s := 0.0;
            rValveDemand_Ar_Pam3s := 0.0;
            rStateTimer_s := 0.0;
            iActiveState := 10; (* Return to STANDBY_PRE_SHOT for next discharge *)
            wSystemStatusWord := wSystemStatusWord AND 16#FFFD; (* Clear Shot Active bit *)
        END_IF;

    80: (* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
          STATE 80: RUNAWAY_ELECTRON_MITIGATION_TRIP
          High-speed Massive Gas Injection (MGI) fired; normal control suspended; safety hold
          ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
        bDetachmentAchieved := FALSE;
        bSystemReady := FALSE;
        rValveDemand_N2_Pam3s := 0.0;
        rValveDemand_Ne_Pam3s := 0.0;
        rValveDemand_Ar_Pam3s := 0.0;
        rStateTimer_s := rStateTimer_s + rCycleTime_s;

        (* Hold in lockout until plasma current is zero and operator acknowledges trip *)
        IF (rPlasmaCurrent_kA < 20.0) AND bAcknowledgeFault THEN
            bMGI_TriggerLatched := FALSE;
            bRunawayInterlockTriggered := FALSE;
            bFastDisruptionDetected := FALSE;
            wAlarmCodeWord := wAlarmCodeWord AND 16#FFF7; (* Clear Runaway Bit *)
            rStateTimer_s := 0.0;
            iActiveState := 10; (* Return to STANDBY *)
        END_IF;

    90: (* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
          STATE 90: FAULT_LOCKOUT_GRACEFUL_DEGRADATION
          Critical safety trip or irrecoverable sensor failure lockout
          ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
        bDetachmentAchieved := FALSE;
        bSystemReady := FALSE;
        rStateTimer_s := rStateTimer_s + rCycleTime_s;

        (* If plasma current is still present, provide safe open-loop protective gas blanket *)
        IF rPlasmaCurrent_kA > 100.0 THEN
            rValveDemand_N2_Pam3s := 25.0; (* Safe protective cooling blanket *)
            rValveDemand_Ne_Pam3s := 0.0;
            rValveDemand_Ar_Pam3s := 0.0;
            bSoftStopRequested := TRUE;
        ELSE
            rValveDemand_N2_Pam3s := 0.0;
            rValveDemand_Ne_Pam3s := 0.0;
            rValveDemand_Ar_Pam3s := 0.0;
        END_IF;

        (* Operator reset acknowledgment logic *)
        IF bAcknowledgeFault AND (NOT bEmergencyStop) AND bEnableSystem AND (rPlasmaCurrent_kA < 50.0) THEN
            wAlarmCodeWord := 16#0000;
            wDiagnosticFaultWord := 16#0000;
            bSoftStopRequested := FALSE;
            bThomson_ChannelA_Fault := FALSE;
            bThomson_ChannelB_Fault := FALSE;
            bThomson_ChannelC_Fault := FALSE;
            bLangmuir_Probe1_Fault := FALSE;
            bLangmuir_Probe2_Fault := FALSE;
            bLangmuir_Probe3_Fault := FALSE;
            rStateTimer_s := 0.0;
            iActiveState := 0; (* Re-bootstrap system *)
        END_IF;

    ELSE
        (* Failsafe default case *)
        iActiveState := 90;
END_CASE;

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
   BLOCK 12: TUNGSTEN MONOBLOCK THERMAL STRESS & CYCLIC DAMAGE INTEGRATION
   Calculates cyclic thermal fatigue damage increment based on Coffin-Manson plastic strain
   ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* Compute tile heating rate d(T_tile)/dt [deg C/s] *)
IF rCycleTime_s > 0.0 THEN
    rTileTempRateOfRise_DegC_s := (rDivertorTileTemp_DegC - rPrevTileTemp_DegC) / rCycleTime_s;
ELSE
    rTileTempRateOfRise_DegC_s := 0.0;
END_IF;
rPrevTileTemp_DegC := rDivertorTileTemp_DegC;

(* Thermomechanical stress intensity factor proportional to temperature gradient:
   sigma_thermal ~ E * alpha / (1 - nu) * DeltaT
   When tile surface exceeds 600 deg C, plastic deformation begins in recrystallized tungsten layer
*)
IF rEstimatedMonoblockTemp_DegC > 600.0 THEN
    rTempCalc1 := (rEstimatedMonoblockTemp_DegC - 600.0) / 600.0;
    rMonoblockStressIncrement := (rTempCalc1 * rTempCalc1) * rCycleTime_s * 1.0E-5;
    rCumulativeThermalFatigue_DPA := rCumulativeThermalFatigue_DPA + rMonoblockStressIncrement;
END_IF;

(* Armor Over-Temperature Safety Trip Evaluation *)
IF rDivertorTileTemp_DegC >= C_CRIT_TILE_TEMP_DEGC THEN
    wAlarmCodeWord := wAlarmCodeWord OR 16#0100; (* Bit 8: Tungsten Tile Critical Overtemperature Trip *)
    bSoftStopRequested := TRUE;
    IF iActiveState <> 80 THEN
        iActiveState := 90; (* Failsafe Lockout *)
    END_IF;
ELSIF rDivertorTileTemp_DegC >= C_MAX_TILE_TEMP_DEGC THEN
    wAlarmCodeWord := wAlarmCodeWord OR 16#0200; (* Bit 9: Tungsten Tile Warning Overtemperature *)
END_IF;

(* Critical Target Heat Flux Safety Trip (> 15.0 MW/m2) *)
IF rEstimatedHeatFlux_MWm2 >= C_CRIT_HEAT_FLUX_TRIP_MWM2 THEN
    wAlarmCodeWord := wAlarmCodeWord OR 16#0400; (* Bit 10: Critical Heat Flux Trip Exceeded *)
    bSoftStopRequested := TRUE;
    IF (iActiveState <> 80) AND (iActiveState <> 90) THEN
        iActiveState := 60; (* Immediately force emergency transient gas puffing *)
    END_IF;
END_IF;

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
   BLOCK 13: ALARM TREE EVALUATION & BITFIELD PACKAGING
   Packages all operational metrics, faults, and alarms into standard 16-bit status words
   ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* Update total combined impurity throughput *)
rTotalImpurityThroughput_Pam3s := rValveDemand_N2_Pam3s + rValveDemand_Ne_Pam3s + rValveDemand_Ar_Pam3s;

(* Update previous cycle actuator memory *)
aU_Prev[1] := rValveDemand_N2_Pam3s;
aU_Prev[2] := rValveDemand_Ne_Pam3s;
aU_Prev[3] := rValveDemand_Ar_Pam3s;

(* Pack Diagnostic Fault Word (wDiagnosticFaultWord):
   Bit 0: Total Thomson Loss
   Bit 1: Total Langmuir Loss
   Bit 2: Langmuir Sheath Breakdown / Short Circuit
   Bit 3: IR Camera Blind / Window Coated
   Bit 4: Thomson Inter-Channel Disagreement Warning
   Bit 5: Degraded Mode 2 Active (Thomson lost)
   Bit 6: Degraded Mode 3 Active (Langmuir lost)
   Bit 7: Critical Degradation Mode 4 Active
   Bit 8: Low N2 Plenum Pressure (< 2.0 bar)
   Bit 9: Low Ne Plenum Pressure (< 2.0 bar)
   Bit 10: Low Ar Plenum Pressure (< 2.0 bar)
   Bit 11: Langmuir Inter-Probe Disagreement Warning
*)
IF bThomson_Disagreement_Warning THEN
    wDiagnosticFaultWord := wDiagnosticFaultWord OR 16#0010; (* Bit 4 *)
ELSE
    wDiagnosticFaultWord := wDiagnosticFaultWord AND 16#FFEF;
END_IF;

IF bLangmuir_Disagreement_Warning THEN
    wDiagnosticFaultWord := wDiagnosticFaultWord OR 16#0800; (* Bit 11 *)
ELSE
    wDiagnosticFaultWord := wDiagnosticFaultWord AND 16#F7FF;
END_IF;

(* Pack System Status Word (wSystemStatusWord):
   Bit 0: System Ready
   Bit 1: Plasma Shot Active
   Bit 2: Flat-Top Reached
   Bit 3: Detachment Ramp Active
   Bit 4: Steady-State Detachment Achieved
   Bit 5: Disruption Precursor Detected
   Bit 6: Soft Stop Requested to Supervisory PCS
   Bit 7: ELM Event Mitigation Active
   Bits 8-11: Active State Machine Index (0 to 9)
   Bits 12-14: Graceful Degradation Level (0 to 4)
   Bit 15: Simulation Mode Active
*)
IF bFastDisruptionDetected THEN
    wSystemStatusWord := wSystemStatusWord OR 16#0020; (* Bit 5 *)
ELSE
    wSystemStatusWord := wSystemStatusWord AND 16#FFDF;
END_IF;

IF bSoftStopRequested THEN
    wSystemStatusWord := wSystemStatusWord OR 16#0040; (* Bit 6 *)
ELSE
    wSystemStatusWord := wSystemStatusWord AND 16#FFBF;
END_IF;

IF (iActiveState = 60) OR bELM_EventTrigger THEN
    wSystemStatusWord := wSystemStatusWord OR 16#0080; (* Bit 7 *)
ELSE
    wSystemStatusWord := wSystemStatusWord AND 16#FF7F;
END_IF;

(* Clear bits 8-15 before repacking state and degradation tiers *)
wSystemStatusWord := wSystemStatusWord AND 16#00FF;

(* Pack State Machine Index into bits 8-11 *)
rTempCalc1 := INT_TO_REAL(iActiveState / 10);
wSystemStatusWord := wSystemStatusWord OR SHL(INT_TO_WORD(REAL_TO_INT(rTempCalc1)), 8);

(* Pack Degradation Tier into bits 12-14 *)
wSystemStatusWord := wSystemStatusWord OR SHL(INT_TO_WORD(iDegradedModeLevel), 12);

(* Pack Simulation Mode into Bit 15 *)
IF bSimulationModeActive THEN
    wSystemStatusWord := wSystemStatusWord OR 16#8000;
END_IF;

END_FUNCTION_BLOCK
